title: 3rd Truth With The Verses Of Resurrection The Ease Of Resurrection By A Single Command

questions.question: What does Allah do to the earth with His command?
questions.answer: He gives the earth life again.

questions.question: In the passage, what does the “single cry” lead to?
questions.answer: It leads to everyone being brought forward before Allah.

questions.question: Which two groups of people are clearly named as being gathered?
questions.answer: Human beings and jinn.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about how long resurrection and gathering will take?
questions.answer: It will happen extremely quickly, even faster than a blink.

questions.question: What does the statement about creating and raising all people “like one soul” mean?
questions.answer: It means all of them are just as easy for Allah as one single being.

questions.question: Besides humans and jinn, what other creatures are mentioned as being gathered?
questions.answer: Animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: Where will they be brought together?
questions.answer: To the place of the great gathering and the great weighing.

questions.question: What important idea is taught by saying one matter does not distract from another?
questions.answer: Allah can handle everything at once without any difficulty.

questions.question: What is one main idea of this whole passage?
questions.answer: Resurrection for all creatures is easy and quick for Allah.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention more than one Qur’anic verse?
questions.answer: To support the message that resurrection is certain, easy, and fast by Allah’s command.

questions.question: What big event is being described in this passage?
questions.answer: The rising again of creation and the final gathering.

questions.question: How is the earth’s return to life connected to Allah in the passage?
questions.answer: It happens by His creative command.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how suddenly the final gathering will happen?
questions.answer: The picture of a single call or command.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show the speed of the Hour?
questions.answer: It is compared to the quickness of blinking.

questions.question: What lesson should a student understand from the phrase about one soul?
questions.answer: Allah does not find many people harder than one person.

questions.question: Who are included in the great assembly according to the passage?
questions.answer: People, jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s power when many different beings are gathered together?
questions.answer: Gathering all of them is easy for His power.

questions.question: What does “one concern does not interfere with another” tell us about Allah’s actions?
questions.answer: Nothing slows Him down or gets in the way of another action.

questions.question: Is the passage teaching weakness or complete ability about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: It teaches complete ability.

questions.question: Why would this passage give hope and certainty to a believer?
questions.answer: It shows that resurrection is fully under Allah’s control and will surely happen.

questions.question: According to the passage, what happens to the earth by Allah’s command?
questions.answer: It is revived after being lifeless.

questions.question: What happens after the single cry mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: All are brought near and made present.

questions.question: Does the passage limit resurrection to only humans? Explain.
questions.answer: No. It also includes jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the speed of the Hour compared with normal human actions?
questions.answer: It says it is faster than something as quick as blinking.

questions.question: If Allah can raise all people as easily as one being, what does that show about His power?
questions.answer: It shows His power is unlimited and not strained by large numbers.

questions.question: What is meant by the “plain of resurrection” in this passage?
questions.answer: It is the place where all are gathered after being raised.

questions.question: What is the “great balance” likely referring to in the passage?
questions.answer: It refers to the weighing and judgment that will happen there.

questions.question: Why does the passage repeat the idea of a single command?
questions.answer: To show that Allah does not need many steps or great effort.

questions.question: What can we infer about the difference between one creature and all creatures for Allah?
questions.answer: There is no difficulty gap for Him between the two.

questions.question: What happened to the later mysteries mentioned at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Their explanation was delayed for another time.

questions.question: What action of Allah is mentioned first in the target passage?
questions.answer: Bringing the earth back to life.

questions.question: What does the passage say will gather everyone together?
questions.answer: One command from Allah.

questions.question: In the passage, what are people and jinn made ready for after that call?
questions.answer: They are made present before Allah in the resurrection gathering.

questions.question: How does the passage help us imagine the short time needed for resurrection?
questions.answer: It uses the example of the eye opening and closing.

questions.question: What does the teaching about one soul say about Allah creating all people?
questions.answer: It says creating and raising all of them is as easy as one.

questions.question: Name two non-human groups, besides jinn, that are included in the final gathering.
questions.answer: Animals and angels.

questions.question: What does the passage show about Allah managing many beings at the same time?
questions.answer: He manages them all without any task blocking another.

questions.question: What is the main cause of resurrection happening so easily in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s command and power.

questions.question: Which is harder for Allah according to this passage: raising one being or raising all beings?
questions.answer: Neither is harder; both are easy for Him.

questions.question: What feeling does the writer show about delaying the later mysteries?
questions.answer: He shows that he is not pleased about delaying them.

questions.question: What happens to the earth when Allah gives His command?
questions.answer: The earth becomes alive again.

questions.question: What does the passage say a single cry will accomplish?
questions.answer: It will bring all those meant for resurrection together before Allah.

questions.question: How many commands are needed for the great gathering, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Only one command is needed.

questions.question: What example from everyday life is used to explain how fast the Hour will come?
questions.answer: A blink of the eye.

questions.question: What does the passage mean when it says all people are like one soul in creation and resurrection?
questions.answer: It means their number does not make the work harder for Allah.

questions.question: Who will be brought to the field of the Supreme Gathering?
questions.answer: All humans, jinn, animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: What does the mention of the great balance suggest will happen after gathering?
questions.answer: It suggests there will be judgment and weighing.

questions.question: What does “one concern does not interfere with another” teach us about Allah?
questions.answer: His actions are perfect, and nothing competes with anything else for His attention.

questions.question: What truth about resurrection is repeated in different ways through the passage?
questions.answer: That it is easy, quick, and fully possible for Allah.

questions.question: At the end of the passage, what is said about the third through thirteenth mysteries?
questions.answer: They are put off until another time.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is one result of Allah’s creative command on the earth?
questions.answer: The earth is restored to life.

questions.question: What does the passage say will happen to men and jinn after the single call?
questions.answer: They will be brought together and made present before Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the time needed for resurrection?
questions.answer: It needs almost no time at all.

questions.question: How does the phrase about a blink help the reader understand the Hour?
questions.answer: It shows the event will happen with amazing speed.

questions.question: What is the meaning of saying that creating and resurrecting all people is like one soul?
questions.answer: Allah’s power handles the whole group as easily as one individual.

questions.question: Which beings are added to men and jinn in the final gathering?
questions.answer: Animals, spirit beings, and angels.

questions.question: What are the two places or events named for this final meeting?
questions.answer: The supreme gathering place and the great balance.

questions.question: If one matter does not disturb another, what does that tell us about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: His power is not limited or distracted by many tasks.

questions.question: What can a Muslim student learn from this passage about Allah’s power over the Last Day?
questions.answer: Allah can bring back all creation easily and without delay.

questions.question: What does the final sentence tell us about the rest of the mysteries?
questions.answer: Their explanation is postponed to a later time.
